inputText: This is Final Pe — PEH so-FEET. Sound: same sounds as Pe, used only at the end of a word. Shape hook: long hanging hook with an inner tooth. Tip: Distinctive inner curl/tooth and long downward tail; final Kaf has no inner tooth; do not mix it up with Final Kaf, Final Nun, Pe.
